structural_change: HUB-SAFE 10-19 successor of hnx_hcq_hub_1019 (n1 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN wire_reach, n2 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD: one tree over the 734.4 square, 48,778 regs, pin flops anchored on all four faces -> pin-flop spread 151 TT / 134 FF, FF hold -70.8 at result_q[721]). Structural: every standard cell (pin registers included) in ONE central 345.6 um band (global-placement region), no face anchoring, so the single clock tree serves a compact register mass and every face pin is one <= ~390 um registered hop; s_i (2,049 b) now pin-registered (qcen SIREG 1, 0 added edges); DRLY 2 = the benched U-ring form (n2 kit ran the default 1); SRAM on the 43.2 lattice (259.2, 302.4); reset copies <= 32 loads; 2-stage reset landing; io_hold_margin 0.03.
